_comment: SCAFFOLD ONLY. verified:false. Every standard is 'needs-reading' with no numeric value: the ordinance source reader must read these from the supplied Arlington Zoning Ordinance PDF (effective 2025-01-28) in docs/sources/, copy each value with its exact quoted source line, and a person must verify it. No zoning value is hand-typed or model-generated here. Section/page references are from the handoff's hand-extracted index and locate where the reader should look; they are NOT the values. Until a value is read and verified, any max-buildable result that depends on it is blocked ('cannot calculate: value not found in source').

maxDensityDuAc.note: handoff index: ~1,200 sq ft of lot per unit (compute du/ac via formula once the lot-per-unit value is read)

maxStories.note: site plan: up to 8 stories / 75 ft; 20+ acres up to 10 stories / 95 ft — read and verify

notes.text: Prose condition to quote verbatim once read, never turned into a number.

maxFar.note: by-right FAR 0.4/0.5/0.6 by site area — read and verify
site plan: multifamily FAR 4.8, 180 ft — read and verify
